sonnet.problem: Story card 9 already says the LORD 'executes righteousness and justice.' The True statement on card 10 repeats that, so the story card gives away the answer. Card 10 is also a True statement that just repeats the card before it.
sonnet.rule: A True statement never just repeats the card before it. / No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: Stop 2 uses a drawer-years joke twice: card 6 ('after years in the back of a drawer') and card 9 ('forgotten in the back of a drawer'). That is more than one per stop.
sonnet.rule: His drawer years carry a joke at most once per stop.
